snippet.title: Little Knight's Last Night - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A meta-horror anomaly game where you play as a QA tester from the 80s. Your job is to look out for anomalies and glitches in their upcoming top-down adventure game. Will you play the game, or will the game play you?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4968650/Little_Knights_Last_Night/

#indiegame #godot #horrorgaming
